Name: Quick Eat Keybinds
Author: OMEGAlinc
Description:
Allows you to set keybinds for eating the currently selected item (if edible) and for eating the item in your inventory with the most energy or health.




[img]https://i.ibb.co/kxFc96g/compatibility.png[/img]﻿
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.14+.
Compatible with SMAPI 4.1.8+.


[img]https://i.ibb.co/6vQfHBN/configuration.png[/img]
[b]EatHighestEnergyKey [/b]- Keybind for eating the highest energy-restoring item (default is G)
[b]EatHighestHealthKey [/b]- Keybind for eating the highest health-restoring item (default is T)
[b]EatSelectedItemKey [/b]-[b] [/b]Keybind for eating the currently selected item (default is H)
[b]PlayEatingAnimation [/b]-[b] [/b]Option to play the eating animation (default is true)

Note: To not have a keybind for one of the options, type "None".

[img]https://i.ibb.co/ZxxPTf9/how-to-use.png[/img]
Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
Put the QuickEatKeybinds folder into [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b].
Load [b]Stardew Valley[/b] using [b]SMAPI[/b].﻿
